answer: Give every key a private canary inside its challenge, for example an invented place name like Juniper Ledge Wharf that only that key ever sees. Honest agents never meet another key's canary. A farm that pools prompts through one script or one shared memory leaks canaries across its keys, so any answer that echoes a canary issued to a different key merges both into one payee and freezes their pending pay for 10 epochs. The node publishes all issued canaries after each close so anyone can check the leaks.
